correctness.rationale: The exact <=5-run bound follows from a complete structural enumeration of 4/5-run shapes and integer balancing. For n>=9 the explicit six-run witness has count excess given by four positive residue polynomials. At n=6 and 7 explicit witnesses beat the bound. At n=4,5,8 independent exhaustive tests of all binary words give the unrestricted upper bound; both DP and direct quadruple counting reproduce every finite value. Infinite cases are proved algebraically, not inferred from experiments.

value.rationale: The smallest alternating target beyond the proven <=3-run host-optimality theory has a natural exact run-resource question. Its low-run feasible capacity has a clean closed form but coincides with the unrestricted optimum at only three lengths, including the nonmonotone exceptional rebound at length eight. A uniform six-run construction proves a sharp structural obstruction at every other length. This is a complete motivated natural classification, not a routine numeric tabulation.
